title: Trace completeness is still caller-asserted rather than independently event-source-bound
falsifier: G8 v2 correctly refuses NO_REENTRY when its supplied trace metadata reports gaps/drops/overflow or an unfinalized interval, but close_with_trace still accepts source_sequence_*, captured_sequence_*, gap/drop/overflow counters, raw_trace_sha256, filter identity, clock identity and finalized directly from its caller. The recorder then factory-seals those caller assertions itself. Likewise observe_reentry still accepts a caller-selected reentry_ref/reentry_sha256. A condition-aware harness can therefore omit a real reentry callback and simultaneously provide apparently complete zero-loss counters, causing a false NO_REENTRY_OBSERVED_IN_COMPLETE_TRACE without an independently authoritative event-source range proving the absence. The new factory seal protects post-construction integrity, not origin independence.

executable_counterexample_shape.setup: Use the same valid ReentryObservationIdentity and complete-window timing as the current negative test helper.
executable_counterexample_shape.intervention: A condition-aware caller receives or knows that a matching runtime reentry occurred but does not call observe_reentry; it calls close_with_trace with source_sequence_start==captured_sequence_start, source_sequence_end==captured_sequence_end, zero gaps/drops/overflow, finalized=true and an arbitrary syntactically valid raw_trace_sha256.
executable_counterexample_shape.current_expected_behavior: Receipt can classify NO_REENTRY_OBSERVED_IN_COMPLETE_TRACE because no REENTRY event is present and caller-supplied TraceCompletenessEvidence.complete is true.
executable_counterexample_shape.required_behavior: UNKNOWN or rejection unless the complete source interval and the presence/absence of matching reentry are derived from an independently factory-validated runtime event-source snapshot/receipt rather than caller booleans/counters/callback omission.

evidence: Current tests construct the negative arm by never calling observe_reentry and then directly supplying all completeness counters through close_with_trace.
Current source constructs TraceCompletenessEvidence inside close_with_trace from those caller-provided values and seals it with the recorder-local factory token.
The prior caller-injected-reentry falsifier already established that condition-blind parameter names do not prove condition-blind event origin.

Existing gwt_runtime_witness.py provides factory-validated runtime witness semantics that may be reusable for positive event origin, but a trustworthy negative still needs an independently complete event-source range or equivalent closed-source attestation.
required_closure: Do not accept arbitrary observe_reentry(reentry_ref, reentry_sha256) as independent positive evidence; bind a validated runtime-origin object or independently captured raw event record.

Do not mint NO_REENTRY_OBSERVED merely from caller-provided sequence/gap/drop/overflow/finalized fields. Consume an independently factory-validated complete event-source window/range whose raw bytes/digest and sequence interval are bound to trace_source_sha256/filter/clock identities.
If no independent complete-range authority exists yet, fail closed: no reentry callback plus caller metadata must remain UNKNOWN, not negative evidence.
Add a regression that simulates omission of an actually available positive event while supplying perfect caller counters and proves it cannot false-green as NO_REENTRY.
Keep G8 mechanism scoped. This falsifier does not authorize semantic GWT/J-Space/runtime-wide/effect/training/completion/whole-system credit.
next_exact_action: Active G8 mutation owner should absorb this falsifier, replace caller-certified completeness/event callbacks with independently source-bound range consumption or downgrade unproven absence to UNKNOWN, add the omission counterexample regression, then rerun exact deterministic release CI before any repository reconciliation or target dispatch.
